stories.detail: Luke Hogan on 44 pts - went top early and stayed there, Penrith's old ladder habit in golf form

stories.title: A Round to Frame
stories.detail: 41 points - the sort of day you tell people about

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 3 big ones on holes 1, 3 & 5 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 17 & 3 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 3 big ones on holes 17, 18 & 1 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Running Hot
stories.detail: 4 straight 3-pointers on holes 2-5

stories.detail: Turned it on - 22 coming home vs 14 out

stories.detail: 307 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Michael Avramovic stormed up 8 places - unlike the actual Storm, who missed the eight

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 3rd - 5 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: From everyone at Wagga Wagga Country Club, welcome William Coghlan of Royal Sydney GC. Have a great round.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 5 marker sitting 8th

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 17 & 18 - the field is on notice

stories.title: Turn for the Better
stories.detail: Caught fire at the turn - 9 across 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 8 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 7, 3-pointer on hole 8 - that's better

stories.title: Jekyll & Hyde
stories.detail: 13 on the front, 21 on the back - two different golfers

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 21 on the front, 12 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 12, 13 & 14 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Nothing But Ones
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers, zero wipes - zero wipes is something to hang your hat on

stories.title: The Impossibility
stories.detail: Zero wipes from 14 holes - is this card even theirs?

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 5 twos on holes 11-15 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 13, 14 & 15

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: The Streaker (Not That Kind)
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 14 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 10-14 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 1-4 - starting to look comfortable

on 21 with 3 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
1 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous

the cushion is 2 - more of a coaster really
hovering 3 above the double blue - altitude: uncomfortable
safe-ish by 5 - the blue balls have come back from further
